bear.story: Barber Lake slips again or overruns beyond the $359M Cipher absorbs; Black Pearl phase 2/Stingray delays; Fluidstack credit wobble or hyperscaler capex retrenchment (Rothschild's credit-market warning) with 10y >5%; ATM issuance funds pipeline at low prices; stock converges to EV/MW-comp value (~$8) or below.

base.story: Black Pearl and Barber Lake rent ramps through H1-27, Stingray on track; NOI run-rate approaches $700-800M by late 2027 but overhead, dilution from Google warrants/converts and high rates keep the stock near DCF/NAV blend (~$13-16).

bull.story: New hyperscale leases on Reveille/Ulysses (270 MW, 2027) and a 2028 GW-scale site signed at AWS-like economics; AI-infrastructure trade re-rates; stock revisits the $30 52-week high and the 2031 converts go in the money.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$8 the equity is worth less than a peer EV/MW comp on contracted capacity alone after net debt, i.e. the market would be pricing a tenant default/termination (most likely Fluidstack at Barber Lake or Stingray, despite Google's partial backstop), a funding gap from further cost overruns, or covenant/minimum-liquidity stress on the revolver - fundamental breakage, not volatility.

key_uncertainties: Construction execution and cost: Barber Lake already slipped from Sep-26 to Q4'26-Q1'27 with $359M overrun borne by Cipher; build costs $8-11M/MW industry-wide.
Tenant credit: Fluidstack (non-investment-grade, Google backstop covers only part of obligations) on Barber Lake/Stingray.
Dilution: 38.8M shares from 2030 converts, 24.2M Google warrants plus make-whole, $1.3B 2031 converts at $16.03, ongoing ATM sales (5.5M shares at $23.50 in Q2).
Rates: 10y at 5.29% compresses value of long-dated fixed-escalator leases and pressures cap rates.
Pipeline conversion: 4.4 GW of uncontracted sites carry most of the bull-case value but need new leases and multibillion financings.
AI capex cycle: hyperscaler off-balance-sheet leverage concerns (Rothschild) could slow new leasing.
reasoning: Facts: Q2-26 revenue $24.8M (BTC only), adj. EBITDA -$30M, net loss $267.5M (incl. $150M warrant mark); ~$11.4B contracted lease revenue with ~$793M avg annual NOI Oct-26..Sep-36; $6.0B gross debt vs $4.56B cash (mostly restricted for construction) [1-3]. Skeptic findings: (a) Barber Lake delivery slipped and Cipher eats the first $359M of overruns, softened by a 10-year follow-on lease with an AI lab worth ~$5.2B in 2036-46 [4,7]; (b) persistent holder supply - Bitfury sold at $25-28 in June and has forward-sale tranches through Nov; Situational Awareness exited 10.4M shares; ~$260-330M insider sales in 12 months, short interest ~14% of float [5,6,9,10]; (c) sell-side drift lower: MS cut to $48.5, new initiations at $23-25 (UBS, Wells) and Rothschild Neutral (~$18, 22% CoE) with a credit-market warning [12-14,19]; (d) Fluidstack counterparty depends on Google's backstop [21]; (e) dilution stack ~77M shares beyond 415M basic [3]. No published short-seller report on CIFR was found and no litigation surfaced; the 'regulatory investigation' line in one trading blog could not be corroborated so it does not move numbers [11]. Valuation: DCF $13.0 (12m), cap-rate NAV $17.0, EV/MW comp $8.2 -> blended $13.65, about 12% below $15.46. Distribution: lognormal-ish centred near $12.8 median with ~75% vol (below the 112% realized because contracted rent should damp vol as revenue arrives), giving P(>= today) ~0.40; scenario mean ~$15.4 (bear $7 30% / base $14.5 50% / bull $30 20%) is consistent with a right-skewed distribution whose median sits below spot. Left tail trimmed (P<$3.87 ~5%) because IG-tenant leases and funded projects protect asset value; right tail capped at ~5% above $39. Research limited: Twelve Data/Alpha Vantage estimates, targets and insider endpoints were unavailable (plan/rate limits); Benzinga and Defense World blocked fetching.
